title: Luscious Dense Malaysian Chicken Curry
description: A dense and bitter Malaysian chicken curry featuring beer, perfect for a sick day, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients and a mortar-pestle-pound method.
instructions: Pound the curry powder, turmeric, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper in a mortar and pestle until well combined.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the pounded spice mixture to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beer to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and continue to simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the curry hot over rice or with naan bread.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
